shortDescription: create or destroy instance templates of Compute Engine of GCP.

options.name: automatic_restart
options.description: Defines whether the instance should be automatically restarted when it is terminated by Compute Engine.

options.name: can_ip_forward
options.description: Set to C(yes) to allow instance to send/receive non-matching src/dst packets.

options.name: credentials_file
options.description: path to the JSON file associated with the service account email

options.name: description
options.description: description of instance template

options.name: disk_auto_delete
options.description: Indicate that the boot disk should be deleted when the Node is deleted.

options.name: disk_type
options.description: Specify a C(pd-standard) disk or C(pd-ssd) for an SSD disk.

options.name: disks
options.description: a list of persistent disks to attach to the instance; a string value gives the name of the disk; alternatively, a dictionary value can define 'name' and 'mode' ('READ_ONLY' or 'READ_WRITE'). The first entry will be the boot disk (which must be READ_WRITE).

options.name: disks_gce_struct
options.description: Support passing in the GCE-specific formatted formatted disks[] structure. Case sensitive. see U(https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/reference/latest/instanceTemplates#resource) for detailed information

options.name: external_ip
options.description: The external IP address to use. If C(ephemeral), a new non-static address will be used.  If C(None), then no external address will be used.  To use an existing static IP address specify address name.

options.name: image
options.description: The image to use to create the instance. Cannot specify both both I(image) and I(source).

options.name: image_family
options.description: The image family to use to create the instance. If I(image) has been used I(image_family) is ignored. Cannot specify both I(image) and I(source).

options.name: metadata
options.description: a hash/dictionary of custom data for the instance; '{"key":"value", ...}'

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the GCE instance template.

options.name: network
options.description: The network to associate with the instance.

options.name: nic_gce_struct
options.description: Support passing in the GCE-specific formatted networkInterfaces[] structure.

options.name: pem_file
options.description: path to the pem file associated with the service account email This option is deprecated. Use 'credentials_file'.

options.name: preemptible
options.description: Defines whether the instance is preemptible.

options.name: project_id
options.description: your GCE project ID

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: service account email

options.name: service_account_permissions
options.description: service account permissions (see U(https://cloud.google.com/sdk/gcloud/reference/compute/instances/create), --scopes section for detailed information) Available choices are: C(bigquery), C(cloud-platform), C(compute-ro), C(compute-rw), C(useraccounts-ro), C(useraccounts-rw), C(datastore), C(logging-write), C(monitoring), C(sql-admin), C(storage-full), C(storage-ro), C(storage-rw), C(taskqueue), C(userinfo-email).

options.name: size
options.description: The desired machine type for the instance template.

options.name: source
options.description: A source disk to attach to the instance. Cannot specify both I(image) and I(source).

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state for the instance template.

options.name: subnetwork
options.description: The Subnetwork resource name for this instance.

options.name: subnetwork_region
options.description: Region that subnetwork resides in. (Required for subnetwork to successfully complete)

options.name: tags
options.description: a comma-separated list of tags to associate with the instance
